DATA:
- States with right-to-work laws (blue): ID, NV, AZ, UT, WY, ND, SD, NE, KS, OK, TX, IA, MO, AR, LA, WI, MI, IN, KY, TN, MS, AL, GA, FL, SC, NC, VA, WV
- States without right-to-work laws (grey): WA, OR, CA, MT, CO, NM, MN, IL, OH, PA, MD, DE, NJ, NY, CT, RI, MA, VT, NH, ME, AK, HI

KEY FACTS:
- Right-to-work laws are prevalent across the South, Southeast, Midwest, and Intermountain West regions of the United States.
- Major states with right-to-work laws include Texas, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, Michigan, and Wisconsin.
- States without right-to-work laws are heavily clustered on the West Coast, in the Northeast, and parts of the upper Midwest and Mid-Atlantic (e.g., California, New York, Pennsylvania, Illinois, Washington).
